verdict.rationale: LanceDB is SDK-first: the docs show vector, full-text and hybrid search, filtering, reranking, table CRUD, indexing and reindexing, quantization, branching, versioning and embeddings all done programmatically across Python, TypeScript and Rust. API-key auth "works in every SDK" for remote tables. However, nothing documents a UI or states that every UI feature has an API equivalent, and the OpenAPI probe found no published REST spec. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, a published OpenAPI/REST spec for the Cloud/Enterprise service, evidence that console or admin functions are API-accessible, and independent corroboration.
